vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.description: A wall of steel. Breaks guards, holds the line and outlasts what it cannot outpace.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.description: Never where the blow lands. Strikes from range, slips away, and finishes in a flurry.

ashcaller.name: Ashcaller
ashcaller.description: Speaks to the ember. Controls ground with fire and keeps the dead at arm's length.
